description: Ministry of Sports - Order made to direct Mr. S.E.R.T.M. Saman Priyantha Bandara to convene the election of the Sri Lanka Judo Association
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Mr. Samasundara Ekanayaka Rajawardhana Tennakoon Mudiyanselage Saman Priyantha Bandara) and his official title (Director General of the Department of Sports Development). It also provides detailed responsibilities and powers assigned to him, including acting as Competent Authority for the Sri Lanka Judo Association and convening elections for new office bearers. This combination of a named person with specific, detailed responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
